claimedEvidence.claim:
Scanned the whole repository (3 files, 1 commit; both local branches identical to origin/main) plus the git history. It is a hand-written static site — index.html, about.html, styles.css — with no image assets, no build tooling, no templating, no CI/deploy config. Four planning-relevant gaps for adding three photo cards under the hero; no code defects, since there is no code.
